notes: NHRA has no Silverado HD rows (its file only holds an S-10 row); every entry is nhra:false.

No engine was 3500-only. 1999-2000: the GMT800 2500 was the light-duty 3/4-ton; heavy 2500/3500 stayed GMT400 C/K (gen 'gmt400' rows). 2001-2004 light-duty 2500: 6.0 per GM 2002 and KBB; GM Canada 2003 also lists the 5.3 for 2500 (single claim, not recorded as a row).
3500-specific rating: 6.0 rated lower above 10,000 lb GVWR (312 hp 2007-2008, 322 hp 2009-2010).

independent_sources counts families: all GM material = 1, Wikipedia = 1, EPA = 1, KBB = 1, each other publication = 1. GM Authority repeats GM figures, so it is counted with GM, not as its own source.
HD trucks are mostly exempt from EPA fuel-economy data; EPA used only where a row exists (1999, 2000, 2002).
